value.rationale: The minimal-dimension obstruction to Gaussian-style attractive precision signs is relevant to binary graphical inference. A sharp phase boundary across open parameter regimes, including zero and opposite signs in the same natural ferromagnetic family, is more structural than a single sign counterexample. The explicit omitted nonlinear interaction term identifies the mechanism and shows conditional independence alone cannot protect least-squares partial correlation signs.
